name: Telegram Bot Studio
description: Build isolated text bots and notebooks; approve secure setup, private tests, releases and user access in your owner chat.

store.tagline: Text bots and notebooks — build privately, approve releases explicitly.
store.description:
Create focused Telegram text assistants and personal notebooks. Start blank or reuse a bot’s behavior without copying its users or connections. Pair each bot independently, save drafts, try an isolated private test and approve the exact release. People request access; you decide who can use each bot. Participant conversations and notes stay separate from owner editing chats. Pause bots and recover deleted entries without erasing their data.

Sensitive setup, private-test starts, releases and access changes use your Möbius owner chat. Keys use sealed input, never chat text. Compatible with the public Möbius platform; a connected, confined Codex runner is needed for text assistance. Telegram Bridge is optional.

This Community edition supports blank, text and notebook bots. It does not include media conversion, browser verification, paid OpenAI pilots, large-file local Telegram transport or direct Bridge customization-chat grants. YouTube notebook links store public metadata only. Installing it does not migrate or change another installed edition. Original app code is MIT licensed; dependency terms are retained. Screenshots use fictional data.
